kind.description: photo or file. Left out: a photo when it's a JPEG, PNG or WebP on a match, venue or referee; otherwise a file.

name.description: A file's name; the file part's own name when left out. It's cleaned, and its ending set to what the file is (FILE-10).

description: The form fields of an upload (multipart/form-data), beside the files: file (a photo, a JPEG, PNG or WebP of at most 10 MB; or a file, a PDF, XLSX, CSV, DOCX, TXT or photo of at most 20 MB) and, optionally, thumb (a small version, an image of at most 1 MB).
